news.title: PM Modi Showcases India as Global AI Hub at VivaTech 2026
news.text: At VivaTech 2026, Narendra Modi highlighted India's rapid progress in Artificial Intelligence and digital innovation. He showcased India's growing AI ecosystem, skilled talent pool, and supportive government initiatives, positioning the country as a global hub for AI development. Modi also emphasized the importance of ethical AI, international collaboration, and technology-driven economic growth.

news.title: India-France Launch 'Bharat Innovates' Initiative
news.text: India and France launched the Bharat Innovates initiative to strengthen collaboration in innovation, startups, and emerging technologies. The program aims to connect entrepreneurs, researchers, and investors from both countries, fostering joint development in areas such as AI, deep tech, and sustainability. The initiative reflects the growing strategic partnership between India and France and their shared focus on driving technological advancement and economic growth.

news.title: UK-India Free Trade Deal to Take Effect in July
news.text: The UK-India Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is set to come into effect in July 2026, marking a major milestone in economic relations between the two countries. The deal aims to reduce tariffs, boost bilateral trade, and create new opportunities for businesses across sectors. It is expected to benefit industries such as manufacturing, technology, pharmaceuticals, and services. The agreement will also improve market access and strengthen investment flows between India and the UK. Overall, the FTA is expected to enhance economic growth and deepen the strategic partnership between the two nations

news.title: AI and Data Centres Become Next Growth Engine for IT Industry
news.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data centres are emerging as key drivers of growth for the global IT industry. Rising demand for AI-powered applications is increasing the need for advanced computing infrastructure and data storage. Companies are investing heavily in data centres to support cloud services, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. This trend is creating new opportunities in software development, cybersecurity, and digital infrastructure. As AI adoption accelerates, data centres are becoming critical to powering the next wave of technological innovation

news.title: Tamil Nadu to Unveil New Industrial Policy
news.text: Tamil Nadu is set to introduce a new industrial policy aimed at accelerating economic growth and attracting fresh investments. The policy is expected to focus on advanced manufacturing, electronics, electric vehicles, renewable energy, and emerging technologies. It will also emphasize job creation, infrastructure development, and ease of doing business. The initiative seeks to strengthen Tamil Nadu's position as one of India's leading industrial and investment destinations. Industry stakeholders anticipate that the policy will drive innovation and boost the state's global competitiveness

news.title: Indian IT Stocks Decline After Accenture Warning
news.text: Indian IT stocks witnessed a decline after Accenture issued a cautious outlook, raising concerns about slower client spending and demand in the technology sector. Investors reacted to the warning as it signaled potential challenges for IT service providers globally. Major Indian IT companies experienced selling pressure amid fears of reduced outsourcing and project delays. The development highlights the industry's sensitivity to global economic conditions and enterprise technology budgets. Market participants will closely watch upcoming earnings and demand trends for further direction.

news.title: L&T Plans ₹18,600 Crore Investment in Tamil Nadu
news.text: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has announced plans to invest ₹18,600 crore in Tamil Nadu, reinforcing the state's position as a major industrial and technology destination. The investment will focus on electronics manufacturing and data centre infrastructure, supporting India's growing digital economy. The project is expected to generate significant employment opportunities and attract allied industries. It also aligns with Tamil Nadu's vision of becoming a leading hub for advanced manufacturing and technology-driven growth. The announcement highlights increasing investor confidence in the state's business-friendly ecosystem and infrastructure.

news.title: OpenAI Introduces Enhanced Controls for ChatGPT Enterprise
news.text: OpenAI has introduced advanced usage analytics and spending controls for ChatGPT Enterprise, helping organizations better manage AI adoption. The new features provide deeper visibility into usage patterns, user activity, and resource consumption across teams. Administrators can now monitor costs more effectively and optimize AI investments. These enhancements aim to improve governance, budgeting, and operational efficiency for enterprise customers. The update reflects OpenAI's continued focus on supporting large-scale, responsible AI deployment in businesses.

news.title: The U.S. Halts Access to Anthropic's Top Models
news.text: Anthropic released Fable 5 and Mythos 5 as parts of its elite new class of AI. However, just days after launch, the U.S. government issued an export control directive that ordered Anthropic to revoke non-U.S. access to these models citing extreme capabilities in code vulnerability discovery and potential biological design. The models were temporarily taken offline while Anthropic reconfigured access protocols

didYouKnow.title: A Day on Venus is Longer Than a Year
didYouKnow.content: Venus takes 243 Earth days to complete one rotation but only 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun, making a day longer than a year.

didYouKnow.title: Octopuses Have Three Hearts
didYouKnow.content: Two hearts pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps blood to the rest of the body. The main heart even stops beating when the octopus swims.

didYouKnow.title: Bananas are Slightly Radioactive
didYouKnow.content: Bananas contain potassium-40, a naturally occurring radioactive isotope. The amount is completely harmless and occurs naturally.

didYouKnow.title: The Human Brain Can Store Around 2.5 Petabytes
didYouKnow.content: Scientists estimate that the human brain's memory capacity is equivalent to about 2.5 million gigabytes of digital storage.

didYouKnow.title: Water Can Exist in Three States at Once
didYouKnow.content: At a specific temperature and pressure called the triple point, water can simultaneously exist as solid, liquid, and gas.
